summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on improving integration with Spark, particularly with the upcoming Spark 4.1 framework and enhancements for small file workloads. Proposals have also been made to address metadata file size issues and improve REST client encoding practices.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal to offload snapshots from metadata.json
Discussion on Java REST client URL encoding issues
Proposal for fine-grained access control in REST catalogs
